title: Rainbow Button
description: CTA cycling the brand ramp, with a matching glow beneath.

a11y.motion: The colour cycle and glow freeze, leaving a static brand gradient with a still glow beneath; the hover glow and press scale remain.
a11y.keyboard: A native <button>: focusable, activates with Enter or Space, with a visible focus-visible outline.
a11y.screenReader: Announced as a button named by its text content.
